title: Formalized Complex Analysis in Lean
abstract: Formalizes Poisson integral formulas on the unit disc and arbitrary centered discs, Herglotz–Riesz representation, and Harnack's inequality on the unit disc, plus infrastructure for univalent function classes S and Σ.

informal.LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.poisson_int: Proves the Poisson integral formula for harmonic functions on the unit disc.
Proves the Poisson integral formula for harmonic functions on arbitrary centered discs.
informal.LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.HerglotzRie: Proves that every positive harmonic function on the unit disc with value 1 at 0 has a unique Herglotz–Riesz representation by a probability measure on the unit circle.
informal.LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.harnack_ine: Proves Harnack's inequality for positive harmonic functions on the unit disc.
